Every group subtotal foots its own funds across all fourteen columns, and the seven subtotals foot to the printed GRAND TOTALS on p42. PAGE 41 PRINTS NO GRAND TOTAL -- it is page 1 of 2 and stops at the LIBRARY subtotal -- so the two pages are read and proved as ONE table, which is what the document is.
